en: Allows users to submit Sales Orders with zero quantity. Useful when rates are fixed but the quantities are not. Eg. Rate Contracts.

en: Allows users to submit Supplier Quotations with zero quantity. Useful when rates are fixed but the quantities are not. Eg. Rate Contracts.
